items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1974-03-28
items.q: That was Lawrence Morell, my cousin.

ctx.x: I forgot to ask you that. Do you remember? Yeah, well that would be easy to remember. What was the first job you played? My first job I played? Oh, man, that's really a fact.

The first job I played, I'll tell you what, I was about 12 years old when I played my first professional job. That was Lawrence Morell, my cousin. You remember Lawrence Morell? Oh yeah. Yeah, well Lawrence was one of the fellas, you know. Well me and Lawrence, sometime we used to hide his fellas, he used to jump. You know what I'm telling you about, what we used to do in that time, we used to play jobs around Franklin Avenue and Charters, Ellison Field and Decatur. See, all around up in there. That's where all…
What about Toker? Did you ever work with Toker? Lawrence Toker? Oh yeah.
